# Public English speech fixture

`english-reference.wav` is the unmodified `test_wavs/0.wav` reference distributed
with the English Zipformer-small model at pinned revision
`e8add5377a6cb7b629b5a0e08d6afe7a73442814`:

https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-zipformer-small-en-2023-06-26/blob/e8add5377a6cb7b629b5a0e08d6afe7a73442814/test_wavs/0.wav

Utterance: LibriSpeech `1089-134686-0001`. Corpus prepared by Vassil Panayotov,
Daniel Povey and contributors from LibriVox readings. License: CC BY 4.0:
https://www.openslr.org/12 and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.
The fixture is used only in repository tests and is not an app asset. It contains
no user recording. The corresponding transcript is available in the model's
`test_wavs/trans.txt`. No changes were made to the downloaded audio.
